edges: Eastern Orthodox Christians are located in the Holy Land.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The three days of Easter are described with contradictory occurrences on the calendar.
Christmas does not fall on the same day every year, while Easter is not yet celebrated in the Holy Land.
The World Council of Churches pushed for a unified method of determining a date based on astronomical occurrences.
Easter's timing is related to Passover due to the crucifixion of Jesus.
The unified method of determining a date didn't catch on.
